notes.title: Paint by Pixel 3 - Now Available!
notes.content:
Paint by Pixel 3 is finally hitting Steam today, and it's bringing a burst of creative brilliance to your screens! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336184/e8c6df6b9a5b92ad86e7747fc7bfb9f8c4cd96e3.gif[/img]

Take the classic art form of pixel art and elevates it to a whole new level, offering you an immersive experience like never before. Unleash your inner artist and watch as your imagination springs to life, one pixel at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336184/7723317ad3aadb0c75c398bba20b498ec9e46505.gif[/img]

To celebrate the game's grand debut on Steam, we're offering an exclusive 20% launch discount for the entire week! Your artistic journey awaits!
